source.description: Grok-first defaults. Each agent maps to the best Grok model for its role, with GPT equivalent as fallback.

equivalents._comment: GPT -> Grok equivalent mapping for reference

perf_notes.grok-3-mini-fast: Fastest Grok: 1.96s coding, 146t/s. Best for high-volume read-only agents (explorer).
perf_notes.grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning: Fast reasoning-capable: 0.68s coding, 1.96s reasoning. Best for analysis/review.
perf_notes.grok-4.20-0309-reasoning: Deep reasoning: 6.3s, 163t/s. Best for planning, complex analysis.
perf_notes.grok-4.3: Frontier: 8.48s, 159t/s. Best for deep verification, complex multi-step.
perf_notes.grok-build-0.1: Build agent: 3.72s, 150t/s. Good for coding tasks.

librarian.role_rationale: External research needs fast reliable model (LazyCodex 4.10.0)

plan.role_rationale: Strategic planning needs deep frontier reasoning (LazyCodex 4.10.0)

metis.role_rationale: Pre-planning contradiction detection with frontier model (LazyCodex 4.10.0)

momus.role_rationale: Plan review needs frontier reasoning and edge-case detection (LazyCodex 4.10.0)

codex-ultrawork-reviewer.role_rationale: Final verification needs frontier model depth (LazyCodex 4.10.0)

coding.role_rationale: Coding role: fast Grok non-reasoning path (LazyCodex 4.10.0)

default.role_rationale: Default execution agent (LFP Hephaestus analogue on Grok)

ulw.role_rationale: Ultrawork orchestrator for Grok-native OMO execution

sisyphus.role_rationale: OMO Sisyphus main orchestrator: follows the upstream agent-model matching guide (Claude/Kimi/GLM/GPT family), not arbitrary Grok mapping

atlas.role_rationale: Grok-native Atlas research and verification conductor mapped to observed OMO ultraresearch/reviewer workflow

oracle.role_rationale: OMO Oracle reasoning specialist kept distinct from Atlas research conductor; maps OMO gpt-5.5/high to Grok deep reasoning with Gemini low fallback from upstream config

sisyphus-junior.role_rationale: OMO Sisyphus Junior delegated execution agent; maps OMO gpt-5.5/medium to Grok reasoning while preserving GPT fallback

ultrabrain.role_rationale: OMO ultrabrain category for genuinely hard logic-heavy tasks; maps gpt-5.5/xhigh to Grok frontier reasoning

deep.role_rationale: OMO deep category for autonomous deep work; maps gpt-5.5/high to Grok deep reasoning with GPT fallback

quick.role_rationale: OMO quick category for trivial low-latency work; maps gpt-5.4-mini to fastest Grok mini

unspecified-low.role_rationale: OMO unspecified-low category for low-effort uncategorized work; maps gpt-5.4-mini to fastest Grok mini

unspecified-high.role_rationale: OMO unspecified-high category for high-effort uncategorized work; maps gpt-5.5/high to Grok deep reasoning with GPT fallback

writing.role_rationale: OMO writing category for documentation and prose; preserves upstream Gemini low model with GPT fallback for availability
